summary: Frontend-only e2e validation of 3 new features on coach test@train.com — (2) Coach AI integration of athlete elite-level/score, (3) Group-mode reports toolbar (PDF/Excel/AI) in Evaluación, (4) Recruiting/Scouting level selector + level-based score standard. ALL 3 features PASS wiring/UI verification.

issues: Pre-existing a11y warnings: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' and 'Missing Description/aria-describedby' — non-blocking, carried over from iteration 113/114/115.
Pre-existing hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> (react-devtools/x-ve overlay artifact) — not new.

critical_code_review_comments: EvaluationTeamMode.jsx: exportReport handler cleanly branches ai vs pdf/xlsx, reads bearer from localStorage.train_token, sends {plan_id, evaluation_type, athlete_ids, group_label, lang}. Toast + panel wiring correct. On 400 it correctly throws with backend's detail message so user sees 'El grupo no tiene datos de evaluación suficientes para el análisis'.

ScoutingModule.js line 313: `criteria?.level_standard ?? criteria?.club_standard ?? 70` — fallback chain is correct. Line 424 shows 'Estándar nivel <level>: <value>' (verified 'Estándar nivel Elite: 90').

AITrainingAssistant.js useEffect on selectedAthlete.id correctly fetches /api/coach/athlete-score/{id}. eliteInfo.evaluation_score + elite_level are correctly forwarded inside athlete_context of /api/ai-assistant/chat. AI response text for Juan Pérez explicitly mentions 'nivel de élite de plata (65/100 pts)' — prompt integration verified end-to-end.
AITrainingAssistant.js chat Input + send Button have NO data-testid — not blocking but should get testids like ai-chat-input / ai-chat-send for future automated regression.

EvaluationTeamMode.jsx line 240 dangerouslySetInnerHTML for AI analysis performs manual HTML escape before bolding **X** — safe. But behavior on 400 is: aiResult stays null (panel not rendered) and toast.error fires; this is correct.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the 3 requested features (wiring verified end-to-end)
